en.stack: NestJS, GraphQL, Azure Kubernetes Service, Jenkins
en.title: Business KPIs aggregated in real time
en.summary: My Team Dashboard brings together AB InBev's business KPIs. I designed its GraphQL APIs in NestJS, which aggregate the data in real time, and deployed its microservices on Azure Kubernetes Service.
en.context: My Team Dashboard shows AB InBev's business KPIs, and it needed APIs that aggregated that data in real time.
en.role: I designed and implemented the GraphQL APIs, brought the automated tests into the Jenkins pipelines and deployed the microservices.
en.built: GraphQL APIs in NestJS aggregate the KPI data in real time. The microservices run on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and the Jenkins CI/CD pipelines run automated unit and end-to-end test suites.
